Thanks Ananya. The staging cluster is still on version 1.27. I think we should go straight to version 1.29.

Great. So we have agreed to upgrade the cluster to version 1.29 before the October 20th release.

Sure, I'll have it done by Friday
I'll send the cost report to the finance team
Someone should probably review the monitoring alerts at some point

meeting_record.summary: The weekly platform sync for October 7th covered infrastructure upgrades and documentation tasks. The team agreed to upgrade the staging cluster to Kubernetes version 1.29 before the October 20th release and decided to maintain the current database schema for the duration of the sprint. No agreement was reached regarding the new on-call rotation or proposed changes to backup schedules and database types.

minutes.discussion: The team discussed upgrading the staging cluster from version 1.27. It was noted that the upgrade budget is $42,000, which is 15% over the initial plan.

Proposals were made to move nightly backups to 2 a.m. and to switch the analytics dashboard to PostgreSQL, but these were deferred. The team confirmed there will be no database schema changes during this sprint.
The team reviewed the new on-call rotation, but concerns regarding weekend shifts prevented a final agreement.
Assignments were made for updating API documentation and delivering a cost report to the finance team. The team also noted a need to review monitoring alerts and update onboarding guides.
